items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: Well, no, no, I just met this fellow, Manny Jones.

ctx.x: Did you meet any other New Orleans music piano players up in Chicago, except mine?
Well, no, no, I just met this fellow, Manny Jones. And I used to go and listen at, when I, book. You remember book? No.

items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: Well we had a piano where we were living and that's why I met Manny Jones.

ctx.x: Did you work much as a musician or just not too busy?

No I was just you know on a vacation like, on a pleasure trip like, you see what I mean? So I went to Chicago and stayed there 60 days and I come on back home and went back to work. I didn't play no music you know. Well we had a piano where we were living and that's why I met Manny Jones. Oh yes. And he says what you gonna do, you gonna stay around Chicago? I says no I'm going back home. I'm going back home to go to work.
What trade did you follow by the way?
